recipes.title: Classic Southern Buttermilk Fried Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken in buttermilk, hot sauce, and salt for at least 4 hours.
Whisk flour and spices together in a shallow dish with 3 tbsp of buttermilk drizzled in to make flaky flakes.
Dredge chicken thoroughly in seasoned flour and rest on rack for 15 minutes.
Fry in 350°F oil in batches: dark meat 14-16 mins, white meat 10-12 mins until 165°F.
Drain on wire rack and serve warm.

recipes.title: Nashville Hot Chicken
ingredients: White bread slices and pickle chips
instructions: Marinate chicken in buttermilk and pickle juice with salt for 4 hours.
Dredge in seasoned flour, dip in buttermilk, dredge again.
Fry at 325°F for 15-18 mins until 165°F.
Whisk hot frying oil into cayenne, brown sugar, chili powder, and spices to form paste.
Brush chicken generously with spicy oil glaze and serve over white bread with pickles.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker BBQ Pulled Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs or breasts
instructions: Place chicken into slow cooker.
Whisk BBQ sauce, vinegar, brown sugar, mustard, Worcestershire, and spices; pour over chicken.
Cover and cook on LOW 5-6 hours or HIGH 3-4 hours.
Shred chicken with two forks directly into juices and toss to coat.
Serve hot on slider buns with coleslaw.

recipes.title: Homestyle Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Melt butter in skillet, sauté onion, carrots, and celery 6-8 minutes.
Stir in flour and cook 1 minute, then whisk in broth and cream until thickened.
Stir in chicken, peas, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Pour into pie crust, top with second crust, crimp edges, vent, and brush with egg wash.
Bake at 400°F for 35-40 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Chicken and Dumplings
instructions: Simmer chicken, stock, onion, carrots, celery, and thyme for 30 minutes.
Remove chicken, shred meat, discard skin and bones, return meat with heavy cream.
Mix flour, baking powder, salt, milk, and melted butter into dumpling dough.
Drop spoonfuls of dough onto simmering stew, cover tightly, and simmer 15 minutes undisturbed.
Garnish with chopped parsley and cracked pepper.

recipes.title: Crispy Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings
ingredients: Celery sticks and blue cheese dressing
instructions: Toss dried wings with baking powder, garlic powder, and salt.
Place wings on wire rack set in rimmed baking sheet.
Bake at 250°F for 20 mins, then 425°F for 30-35 mins until very crisp.
Whisk hot sauce, melted butter, and honey.
Toss hot wings in sauce and serve with celery and blue cheese.

recipes.title: Herb-Roasted Spatchcock Chicken
instructions: Remove backbone from chicken and press flat.
Mix softened butter, garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Rub compound butter under skin and over outside of chicken.
Place on sheet pan with lemon halves; roast at 450°F for 40-45 mins until breast is 160°F and thighs 175°F.
Rest 10 minutes before carving.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan Garlic Chicken
ingredients: 2 large chicken breasts, halved horizontally into cutlets
instructions: Season cutlets with Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper; sear in olive oil 4-5 mins per side until done, then remove.
Sauté garlic and sun-dried tomatoes in same pan for 1 min.
Whisk in cream and broth, simmer 3 minutes, then stir in Parmesan until melted.
Stir in spinach until wilted, return chicken to skillet, and spoon sauce over top.

recipes.title: Classic Chicken Piccata
instructions: Dredge chicken cutlets lightly in flour; sear in oil and 1 tbsp butter for 3 mins per side until golden.
Deglaze pan with white wine and chicken stock, simmering 3 minutes until reduced.
Stir in lemon juice and capers, remove from heat, and swirl in remaining 2 tbsp cold butter.
Return chicken to warm through, top with parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Southern Chicken Salad with Pecans & Grapes
instructions: Whisk mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add cubed chicken, grapes, pecans, celery, and green onions.
Fold gently until thoroughly coated.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving on croissants or lettuce cups.

recipes.title: Chicken Tinga (Tinga de Pollo)
ingredients: 3 canned chipotles in adobo plus 2 tbsp sauce
Tostada shells, refried beans, cotija cheese, crema
instructions: Blend tomatoes, chipotles, adobo sauce, garlic, oregano, and broth until smooth.
Sauté sliced onion in oil until softened and lightly golden.
Pour chipotle-tomato sauce into onions and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add shredded chicken, simmer 8-10 minutes until thick and sauce clings to meat.
Serve over bean-spread tostadas with cotija and crema.

recipes.title: Authentic Pollo Asado (Citrus-Achiote Grilled Chicken)
ingredients: Warm corn tortillas and charred limes
instructions: Dissolve achiote paste in orange juice, lime juice, garlic, cumin, oregano, and olive oil with 1.5 tsp salt.
Marinate chicken in citrus-achiote marinade for at least 4 hours.
Grill over medium-hot coals or cast iron grill for 25-30 minutes, turning regularly, until charred and 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes, carve, and serve with warm tortillas and salsa.

recipes.title: Arroz con Pollo a la Criolla
ingredients: 1/2 cup sofrito (onion, bell pepper, garlic, cilantro)
instructions: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and oregano; brown thighs in oil in a Dutch oven, then remove.
Sauté sofrito, sazón, and alcaparrado in rendered fat for 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato sauce and rinsed rice, coating grains for 2 minutes.
Add chicken broth, return chicken on top, bring to boil, then cover and simmer on low for 25 minutes.
Scatter peas over rice, cover for 5 minutes off heat, and fluff with a fork.

recipes.title: Enchiladas Verdes con Pollo
ingredients: 1.5 cups shredded Monterey Jack or Oaxaca cheese
instructions: Boil tomatillos, peppers, onion, and garlic for 8 minutes until softened. Blend with cilantro, salt, and 1/2 cup cooking water.
Flash-fry tortillas in hot oil for 5 seconds per side to soften.
Roll shredded chicken inside tortillas and place seam-side down in baking dish.
Pour warm green salsa evenly over enchiladas and top with shredded cheese.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until bubbly and cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Peruvian Pollo a la Brasa with Aji Verde
ingredients: 2 tbsp dark beer or red wine vinegar
Aji Verde Sauce: 3 jalapeños, 1 cup cilantro, 1/2 cup mayo, 1/4 cup cotija, 1 clove garlic, 1 tbsp lime juice blended
instructions: Whisk soy sauce, beer/vinegar, cumin, paprika, garlic, oregano, and salt; rub thoroughly over chicken and marinate overnight.
Roast chicken on a wire rack at 425°F for 45-50 minutes until skin is crisp and internal temperature is 165°F.
Blend all Aji Verde ingredients in a food processor until smooth and creamy.
Carve chicken and serve with thick-cut fries and generous spoonfuls of spicy Aji Verde.

recipes.title: Sizzling Chicken Fajitas with Peppers and Onions
ingredients: 1.5 lbs chicken breasts, cut into strips
instructions: Toss chicken strips in lime juice, 1 tbsp olive oil, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Heat cast iron skillet smoking hot with 1 tbsp oil. Cook chicken 6-7 minutes until browned and cooked; transfer to plate.
Add peppers and onions to hot skillet with remaining oil; sear 4-5 minutes until blistered but crisp-tender.
Return chicken to skillet to sizzle together for 1 minute.
Serve family-style straight from the skillet with warm flour tortillas and toppings.

recipes.title: Pollo Guisado (Dominican Braised Chicken)
ingredients: 3 lbs bone-in chicken, cut into small pieces
instructions: Season chicken with adobo, garlic, lime juice, salt, and pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy caldero or Dutch oven; add brown sugar and let it caramelize to dark amber.
Immediately add chicken pieces, stirring to coat in caramelized sugar for a rich mahogany color.
Add onion, bell pepper, tomato paste, olives, and chicken broth.
Cover and simmer on low for 30 minutes until chicken is tender and gravy is rich and thick.

recipes.title: Chicken Pozole Verde
ingredients: 2 cans (29 oz each) white hominy, drained and rinsed
Shredded cabbage, radishes, lime wedges, tostadas
instructions: Simmer chicken in broth with onion and garlic for 25 minutes; shred meat and return to broth.
Blend boiled tomatillos, roasted poblanos, jalapeños, cilantro, and 1 cup broth into a vibrant green purée.
Pour green salsa and hominy into simmering broth. Stir in Mexican oregano and simmer 30 minutes.
Ladle into deep bowls and serve with shredded cabbage, sliced radishes, dried oregano, and limes.

recipes.title: Chicken Quesadillas with Smoky Chipotle Crema
ingredients: 2 cups shredded Monterey Jack and Cheddar cheese
1/2 cup diced onions and bell peppers
Chipotle crema: 1/2 cup sour cream, 1 chipotle in adobo minced, 1 tbsp lime juice
instructions: Season shredded chicken with cumin and smoked paprika.
Place tortillas on a warm griddle; sprinkle half of each tortilla with cheese, chicken, peppers, onions, and more cheese.
Fold tortillas in half and cook 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and cheese is fully melted.
Whisk sour cream, minced chipotle, and lime juice.
Cut quesadillas into wedges and serve with chipotle crema and pico de gallo.

recipes.title: Colombian Ajiaco (Chicken, Corn & Potato Soup)
ingredients: 3 ears sweet corn, cut into rounds
1 lb russet potatoes, peeled and diced (for thickening)
Heavy cream, capers, and avocado cubes for garnish
instructions: Simmer chicken breasts in stock with green onions and garlic for 25 minutes; remove chicken, shred meat, and set aside.
Add diced russet potatoes and corn to broth; simmer 25 minutes until potatoes dissolve and thicken broth.
Add sliced red potatoes and guascas; simmer 15 minutes until tender.
Return shredded chicken to hot soup.
Serve in shallow bowls garnished with capers, a swirl of heavy cream, and diced avocado.

recipes.title: Crispy Baked Chicken Parmigiana
instructions: Dredge chicken cutlets in flour, dip in beaten eggs, then coat in breadcrumb-Parmesan mixture.
Pan-fry cutlets in olive oil over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side until golden; drain.
Spread 1/2 cup marinara in a 9x13 baking dish, arrange chicken cutlets, top with remaining marinara and mozzarella.
Bake at 400°F for 15-20 minutes until cheese is browned and bubbly.
Garnish with torn fresh basil and serve with pasta.

recipes.title: Rustic Chicken Cacciatore (Hunter's Stew)
ingredients: 1 can (28 oz) crushed San Marzano tomatoes
instructions: Brown seasoned chicken pieces in olive oil in a Dutch oven, then transfer to a plate.
In same pot, sauté onion, bell pepper, and mushrooms for 6 minutes until tender; stir in garlic.
Pour in red wine, scraping up browned bits, and simmer 2 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes, oregano, and olives; return chicken and rested juices to pot.
Cover and simmer on low for 35 minutes until chicken is meltingly tender.

recipes.title: Chicken Marsala with Cremini Mushrooms
instructions: Dredge cutlets in seasoned flour; sear in 2 tbsp oil and 1 tbsp butter for 3 mins per side; remove to plate.
Add sliced mushrooms to pan with 1 tbsp butter; sauté 5 minutes until browned.
Add garlic, cook 30 seconds, then pour in Marsala wine and chicken stock.
Simmer 4-5 minutes until sauce reduces by half; swirl in remaining 1 tbsp cold butter.
Return cutlets to sauce to glaze; garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon Herb Chicken Souvlaki
recipes.chicken_cut: boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs, cubed
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breasts or thighs, cut into 1-inch cubes
Warm pita bread and tzatziki sauce
instructions: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, thyme, 1.5 tsp salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Toss chicken cubes in marinade and refrigerate for 2-4 hours.
Thread chicken tightly onto skewers.
Grill over medium-high heat for 10-12 minutes, turning every 3 minutes, until lightly charred and 165°F.
Slide meat off skewers into warm pita pockets with tzatziki, tomatoes, and red onions.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon Potatoes and Roast Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs bone-in chicken thighs and drumsticks
2 lbs Yukon gold potatoes, cut into wedges
instructions: Arrange potato wedges and chicken pieces in a large roasting pan.
Whisk olive oil, chicken broth, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, 2 tsp salt, and 1 tsp black pepper.
Pour marinade evenly over chicken and potatoes, tossing potatoes to coat.
Roast at 400°F for 50-55 minutes, basting once halfway through, until potatoes are tender with crispy edges and chicken skin is deep golden.
Spoon pan juices over top before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Saltimbocca with Prosciutto and Sage
instructions: Place 2 sage leaves on each chicken cutlet, cover with a slice of prosciutto, and pin securely with a toothpick.
Dust bottom side of cutlet lightly in flour.
Melt 1.5 tbsp butter with 1 tbsp olive oil in skillet over medium heat.
Cook chicken prosciutto-side down for 2 minutes until crisp, flip, and cook 3 minutes until done; transfer to warm plate.
Deglaze pan with white wine, simmer 2 minutes, remove from heat, and swirl in remaining butter; pour pan sauce over chicken.

recipes.title: Caprese Stuffed Chicken Breast with Balsamic Glaze
instructions: Cut a deep horizontal pocket into thick side of each chicken breast, taking care not to cut all the way through.
Season chicken inside and out with olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Stuff each pocket with alternating slices of tomato, fresh mozzarella, and whole basil leaves; seal with toothpicks.
Sear stuffed breasts in a hot oven-safe skillet for 2 minutes per side to brown.
Transfer to 375°F oven and bake 18-20 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F.
Drizzle generously with thick balsamic glaze before serving.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Lemon Herb Sheet-Pan Chicken & Veggies
ingredients: 1.5 lbs chicken thighs, cut in half
instructions: Toss chicken pieces and vegetables on a large rimmed sheet pan with olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Spread into a single even layer with chicken skin-side up.
Roast at 425°F for 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are caramelized.
Scatter crumbled feta cheese and fresh parsley over hot sheet pan immediately out of oven.

recipes.title: Chicken Milanese with Arugula Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup olive oil for shallow frying
instructions: Dredge pounded cutlets in flour, beaten egg, then breadcrumbs, pressing to adhere.
Shallow-fry cutlets in hot olive oil for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and crispy; drain on paper towels.
Toss baby arugula and cherry tomatoes with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Top each hot crispy cutlet with a generous mound of dressed arugula salad and shaved Parmesan.

recipes.title: Rosemary Garlic Chicken Roulade
ingredients: 2 large chicken breasts, butterflied and pounded flat
1 cup cooked chopped spinach, squeezed dry
instructions: Mix ricotta, Parmesan, squeezed dry spinach, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Spread filling evenly across pounded chicken breasts, leaving a 1/2-inch border.
Roll chicken up tightly into cylindrical roulades and tie with kitchen twine at 1-inch intervals.
Sear rolled breasts in olive oil with rosemary sprigs for 4 minutes to brown outside.
Transfer to 375°F oven and bake 25-30 minutes until internal temperature hits 165°F; rest 10 minutes and slice into medallions.

recipes.title: Japanese Chicken Teriyaki with Glazed Scallions
ingredients: Toasted sesame seeds and steamed rice
instructions: Score chicken meat lightly and pat skin completely dry.
Cook chicken skin-side down in a dry skillet over medium heat for 7-8 minutes until skin is deeply crisp and golden; flip and cook 3 minutes.
Pour off excess fat from pan; add scallion batons.
Combine soy sauce, mirin, sake, sugar, and grated ginger; pour into skillet.
Simmer vigorously for 3-4 minutes while continuously spooning bubbling glaze over chicken until glossy and thick. Slice and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Crispy Japanese Chicken Karaage with Kewpie
ingredients: 1.5 lbs chicken thighs, cut into 1.5-inch pieces
instructions: Marinate chicken pieces in soy sauce, sake, ginger, garlic, and sesame oil for 30 minutes.
Dredge each piece generously in potato starch, shaking off excess.
Heat oil to 330°F (165°C); fry chicken for 3-4 minutes until pale golden; remove to rack and rest 4 minutes.
Increase oil temperature to 375°F (190°C); flash-fry chicken for 60-90 seconds until ultra-crisp and deep mahogany.
Drain and serve hot with lemon wedges and Japanese Kewpie mayonnaise.

recipes.title: Crispy Chicken Katsu with Tonkatsu Sauce
ingredients: Shredded green cabbage and tonkatsu sauce
instructions: Season cutlets with salt and pepper; dredge in flour, dip in beaten eggs, then press firmly into panko for full coverage.
Heat 1/2 inch of oil in a wide skillet to 350°F (175°C).
Fry cutlets 3-4 minutes per side until deep golden and crisp; transfer to paper towel lined rack.
Slice crosswise into 1/2-inch strips.
Serve immediately over finely shredded green cabbage with sweet-savory tonkatsu sauce.

recipes.title: Authentic Yakitori (Charred Chicken & Scallion Skewers)
ingredients: 1.5 lbs chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces
2 bunches thick scallions (negi), cut into 1-inch lengths
Tare Sauce: 1/2 cup soy sauce, 1/2 cup mirin, 1/4 cup sake, 2 tbsp brown sugar simmered until thickened
instructions: Thread chicken pieces and scallion lengths alternately onto soaked bamboo skewers.
Grill over high heat (preferably binchotan charcoal) for 3-4 minutes until lightly charred.
Dip skewers directly into warm tare sauce (or brush generously).
Return to grill for 2 minutes to caramelize sauce; dip in tare a second time and finish cooking until 165°F.
Dust with shichimi togarashi (seven spice) and serve hot.

recipes.title: Korean Fried Chicken with Sweet & Spicy Yangnyeom Glaze
ingredients: Yangnyeom Glaze: 3 tbsp gochujang, 3 tbsp ketchup, 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp minced garlic, 1 tbsp sesame oil
Toasted sesame seeds and crushed peanuts
instructions: Toss chicken wings with starch, flour, egg, and 1 tsp salt until a thin batter coats each wing.
First fry: cook in 325°F oil for 8-10 minutes until pale and cooked through; drain on wire rack.
Second fry: flash-fry at 375°F for 2-3 minutes until shatteringly crisp.
Simmer glaze ingredients together in a wok for 2 minutes until bubbly and glossy.
Toss hot double-fried wings in glaze until coated; top with sesame seeds and crushed peanuts.

recipes.title: Korean Chicken Bulgogi (Dak Bulgogi)
instructions: Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, grated pear, garlic, ginger, and gochugaru.
Toss sliced chicken and onion in marinade; let rest 30 minutes in refrigerator.
Heat a wide cast iron pan or grill over high heat.
Sear chicken and onions in batches without crowding for 5-6 minutes until edges are caramelized and charred.
Garnish with scallions and sesame seeds; serve with steamed rice and lettuce wraps (ssam).

recipes.title: Classic Kung Pao Chicken with Szechuan Peppercorns
recipes.chicken_cut: boneless chicken breast or thighs, cubed
ingredients: 1.25 lbs chicken breast or thighs, diced into 1/2-inch cubes
3 green onions, white and green parts separated and sliced
Kung Pao Sauce: 2 tbsp Chinkiang black vinegar, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp dark soy, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp cornstarch, 2 tbsp water
instructions: Marinate chicken cubes with 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp Shaoxing wine, and 1 tsp cornstarch for 15 minutes.
Heat wok over high heat with 2 tbsp oil; stir-fry dried chilies and Szechuan peppercorns for 20 seconds until fragrant.
Add chicken and sear 3-4 minutes until lightly browned.
Add white scallions, garlic, and ginger; stir-fry 1 minute.
Pour in Kung Pao sauce, toss until glossy and clinging to chicken, then fold in roasted peanuts and green scallions.

recipes.title: Authentic Chinese General Tso's Chicken
ingredients: 1.5 lbs chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized cubes
General Tso Sauce: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 3 tbsp rice vinegar, 3 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp hoisin, 1 tbsp tomato paste, 1/2 cup chicken stock, 1 tbsp cornstarch
instructions: Coat chicken cubes in egg white, 1 tbsp soy sauce, and toss thoroughly in cornstarch to create a dry, craggy coating.
Fry in 375°F oil for 4-5 minutes until golden and very crisp; drain on wire rack.
In a clean wok, sauté dried chilies, minced ginger, and garlic for 30 seconds.
Pour in sauce mixture and stir constantly until it thickens into a glossy glaze.
Toss hot crispy chicken in sauce for 30 seconds until coated; serve immediately surrounded by steamed broccoli.

recipes.title: Traditional Hainanese Chicken Rice
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice, washed and drained
Chili Sauce: fresh red chilies, garlic, ginger, lime juice, chicken broth blended
Ginger-Scallion Sauce: minced ginger, scallions, hot oil, salt
instructions: Stuff chicken cavity with ginger slices and scallions. Submerge in large pot of salted water; bring to boil, then immediately turn to lowest heat, cover, and gently poach for 45 minutes.
Plunge poached chicken into ice bath for 10 minutes to set skin and create gelatinous texture; rub skin with sesame oil.
In a saucepan, sauté garlic and ginger in chicken fat/oil; add rice and toast 2 minutes.
Pour in 2.5 cups of poaching broth to cook the fragrant rice.
Carve chicken, serve over seasoned rice with side bowls of hot broth, chili sauce, and dark soy.

recipes.title: Cantonese Soy Sauce Chicken (Si Yau Gai)
instructions: In a deep pot, combine light soy, dark soy, Shaoxing wine, rock sugar, star anise, cinnamon, tangerine peel, ginger, scallions, and 2 cups water; bring to boil until sugar dissolves.
Lower whole chicken breast-side down into master stock. Reduce heat to very low, cover, and gently poach for 20 minutes.
Carefully flip chicken, cover, and poach another 20 minutes; turn off heat and let steep in warm liquid for 15 minutes.
Remove chicken, cool slightly, brush with sesame oil, and chop into traditional bone-in pieces.
Drizzle with a ladle of master poaching sauce and serve with ginger-scallion oil.

recipes.title: Thai Green Curry Chicken with Bamboo & Basil
ingredients: 3 tbsp authentic Thai green curry paste
1 tbsp palm sugar or brown sugar
instructions: Skim 1/4 cup thick cream from top of coconut milk into saucepan; fry over medium heat until oil separates.
Add green curry paste and sauté 2 minutes until aromatic.
Add chicken slices and toss 2 minutes until outside changes color.
Pour in remaining coconut milk and chicken stock; add bamboo shoots and eggplant.
Simmer 10 minutes until chicken and vegetables are tender. Stir in fish sauce, palm sugar, and fresh Thai basil off heat. Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow Gai)
recipes.chicken_cut: ground chicken or finely minced thighs
ingredients: 1.5 cups fresh holy basil or Thai basil leaves
6 Thai bird's eye chilies, pounded in mortar
Crispy fried eggs (kai dao) for topping
instructions: Pound chilies and garlic in mortar and pestle into a rough paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in wok smoking hot; add chili-garlic paste and stir-fry 20 seconds.
Add minced chicken, breaking up with spatula, and stir-fry over high heat for 3-4 minutes until cooked.
Add oyster sauce, soy sauce, dark soy, and fish sauce; toss 1 minute.
Turn off heat, toss in fresh basil leaves until wilted.
Serve immediately over jasmine rice topped with a crispy fried egg with runny yolk.

recipes.title: Classic Filipino Chicken Adobo
ingredients: 1/2 cup cane vinegar (or distilled white vinegar)
1 whole head of garlic, peeled and crushed
instructions: In a Dutch oven, combine chicken, soy sauce, vinegar, crushed garlic, peppercorns, bay leaves, and water.
Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then lower heat, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes without stirring.
Uncover, turn chicken pieces, and simmer another 15 minutes until sauce reduces to a rich glaze.
Optional: sear chicken pieces in a separate pan for 2 minutes to crisp skin, then return to sauce.
Serve hot over mounds of warm garlic fried rice (sinangag).

recipes.title: Filipino Chicken Inasal (Calamansi & Lemongrass Grilled Chicken)
ingredients: Annatto Basting Oil: 1/4 cup neutral oil heated with 2 tbsp annatto seeds and 2 tbsp melted butter
instructions: Blend calamansi juice, coconut vinegar, lemongrass, ginger, garlic, brown sugar, and 1 tbsp salt.
Score chicken skin and marinate leg quarters in refrigerator for 4-6 hours.
Make annatto basting oil by warming seeds in oil until deep reddish-orange; strain out seeds and mix with butter.
Grill chicken over hot coals for 30-35 minutes, turning frequently and brushing liberally with annatto oil every 5 minutes until glossy reddish-gold and 165°F.
Serve with garlic rice and spicy vinegar dipping sauce (sinamak).

recipes.title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Grilled Chicken (Ga Nuong Sa)
ingredients: Scallion oil and crushed roasted peanuts
instructions: Mix minced lemongrass, fish sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, oil, garlic, and shallots.
Toss chicken thighs in marinade and let sit for at least 2 hours.
Grill over medium-high coals or cast iron grill pan for 6-7 minutes per side until charred on edges and fully cooked.
Brush with warm scallion oil and sprinkle with crushed peanuts.
Serve with vermicelli rice noodles (bun), fresh mint, cucumbers, and nuoc cham dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Authentic Vietnamese Chicken Pho (Pho Ga)
ingredients: 1 large onion, charred in dry skillet
Flat rice noodles, fresh cilantro, Thai basil, bean sprouts, lime
instructions: Char unpeeled onion and ginger in a dry skillet until blackened; toast star anise, cinnamon, and coriander seeds until fragrant.
In a stockpot, bring water to boil with charred aromatics, toasted spices, 1 tbsp salt, and chicken.
Simmer gently on low heat for 45 minutes skimming any impurities; remove chicken and let cool.
Shred meat from bones, return bones to stockpot, and simmer broth for another 45 minutes; season with fish sauce and rock sugar.
Place cooked rice noodles in bowls, top with shredded chicken, pour piping hot broth over, and garnish with fresh herbs.

recipes.title: Balinese Chicken Satay with Spicy Peanut Sauce
recipes.chicken_cut: chicken breast or thighs, cut into strips
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken thighs, cut into long strips
Peanut Sauce: 3/4 cup creamy peanut butter, 1 cup coconut milk, 2 tbsp kecap manis, 1 tbsp red curry paste, 1 tbsp lime juice simmered 5 mins
instructions: Thread chicken strips accordion-style onto soaked bamboo skewers.
Brush with marinade of kecap manis, coriander, turmeric, garlic, and lime juice.
Grill over hot coals for 8-10 minutes, turning frequently and brushing with kecap manis.
Simmer peanut sauce ingredients until smooth and fragrant.
Serve skewers warm with spicy peanut sauce, lime wedges, and compressed rice cakes (lontong).

recipes.title: Malaysian Chicken Rendang
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken thighs, cut into large chunks
Spice Paste: 6 shallots, 4 cloves garlic, 1-inch galangal, 1-inch ginger, 2 stalks lemongrass, 8 soaked dried chilies blended
instructions: Blend spice paste ingredients with a little oil until smooth.
Fry spice paste in Dutch oven for 8-10 minutes until fragrant and oil separates.
Add chicken chunks and toss 2 minutes to coat.
Pour in coconut milk, lime leaves, and turmeric leaf; bring to boil, then simmer on low heat uncovered for 45 minutes.
Stir in toasted coconut (kerisik), salt, and palm sugar; continue cooking until liquid evaporates and chicken is coated in dark, aromatic toasted spice paste.

recipes.title: Thai Coconut Chicken Soup (Tom Kha Gai)
recipes.chicken_cut: boneless chicken breasts or thighs, sliced
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast or thighs, sliced thin
2 stalks lemongrass, bruised and cut in batons
8 oz fresh oyster or straw mushrooms
instructions: Bring chicken stock and coconut milk to a gentle simmer in a pot with galangal, lemongrass, and kaffir lime leaves for 8 minutes to infuse flavors.
Add sliced chicken and mushrooms; simmer gently 6-8 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Season with fish sauce and chili jam (nam prik pao).
Remove pot from heat and stir in fresh lime juice (adding off heat keeps coconut milk from curdling).
Ladle into bowls, discard tough stalks before eating, and garnish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Indonesian Ayam Goreng Lengkuas (Galangal Fried Chicken)
instructions: Blend shallots, garlic, coriander, turmeric, and 1 tsp salt into a paste; mix thoroughly with grated galangal.
In a wok, combine chicken pieces, galangal mixture, lemongrass, bay leaves, and 1.5 cups water; simmer covered for 25 minutes until chicken is tender.
Remove chicken and strain galangal shreds from remaining broth.
Deep fry chicken pieces in 375°F oil for 3-4 minutes until golden crisp; remove.
Fry the spiced galangal shreds in the hot oil until crispy and golden brown; scatter crisp aromatic galangal flakes over chicken before serving.

recipes.title: Restaurant-Style Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
Makhani Gravy: 4 tbsp butter, 1 large can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes, 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, 1 tsp fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi), 3/4 cup heavy cream
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, chili powder, and garam masala for 2 hours.
Broil chicken pieces on high on a foil-lined baking sheet for 10-12 minutes until charred at edges; set aside.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in skillet, add ginger-garlic paste, then pour in crushed tomatoes; simmer 15 minutes, then blend smooth.
Return purée to skillet, add kasuri methi, remaining 2 tbsp butter, and heavy cream.
Add charred chicken and simmer gently for 8-10 minutes until sauce is velvety and rich. Serve with garlic naan.

recipes.title: Classic Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.chicken_cut: boneless skinless thighs or breasts, cubed
ingredients: Masala Sauce: 1 diced onion, 3 cloves garlic, 1 tbsp ginger, 1 can (14 oz) tomato purée, 1 tbsp garam masala, 1/2 cup heavy cream
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, and spices for at least 2 hours.
Thread onto skewers and broil on top oven rack at 500°F for 10 minutes until charred; remove meat from skewers.
In a large skillet, sauté diced onion until golden brown; add minced garlic, ginger, and garam masala.
Add tomato purée and simmer 10 minutes; stir in heavy cream until sauce turns vibrant orange.
Fold in charred chicken tikka pieces and simmer 5 minutes. Garnish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Hyderabadi Chicken Dum Biryani
ingredients: 3 cups aged Basmati rice, soaked 30 mins
2 large onions, thinly sliced and fried crisp (birista)
1/4 cup warm milk infused with saffron threads
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, biryani masala, ginger-garlic paste, half the fried onions, mint, cilantro, and salt for 3 hours.
Parboil soaked Basmati rice in whole-spiced boiling water for 5 minutes until 70% cooked; drain.
In a heavy Dutch oven, spread marinated chicken across bottom in an even layer.
Top chicken with parboiled rice, drizzle with saffron milk and melted ghee, and scatter remaining fried onions and mint.
Seal pot tightly with foil and lid; cook on medium-high for 10 mins, then lowest heat for 35 mins (dum). Rest 10 mins and gently fluff layers.

recipes.title: Authentic Tandoori Chicken Legs
ingredients: 4 chicken leg quarters, skin removed and deeply slashed
1/2 cup thick hung curd or Greek yogurt
Sliced red onions and mint chutney
instructions: Slash chicken legs with deep cuts across bone.
Rub chicken with 1 tbsp lemon juice and salt; rest 15 minutes.
Mix yogurt, mustard oil, Kashmiri chili, ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, and crushed fenugreek into thick red marinade.
Coat chicken thoroughly inside cuts; marinate refrigerated for at least 6 hours.
Roast on a wire rack at 475°F (or outdoor grill) for 30-35 minutes, turning once and basting with ghee, until charred on edges and 165°F.

recipes.title: Spicy Goan Chicken Vindaloo
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken thighs, cut into chunks
Vindaloo Paste: 8 dried Kashmiri chilies, 1/4 cup white vinegar, 6 cloves garlic, 1-inch ginger, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp mustard seeds, 4 cloves, 1 cinnamon stick blended smooth
instructions: Blend spices, garlic, ginger, and vinegar into a smooth, fiery red paste.
Coat chicken pieces in vindaloo paste and marinate for 2 hours.
Sauté sliced onions in 3 tbsp oil over medium heat until deep brown and caramelized (15 mins).
Add marinated chicken with all paste; sauté 5 minutes until oil starts to separate.
Add tomato paste, 1 cup water, and jaggery; cover and simmer on low for 25 minutes until chicken is tender and sauce is thick and tangy.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Korma with Cashews & Cardamom
recipes.chicken_cut: boneless chicken breasts or thighs, cubed
ingredients: 1/2 cup raw cashews soaked in warm water and blended to smooth paste
2 large onions, sliced and fried golden brown
instructions: Blend fried onions and yogurt into a smooth paste.
Heat ghee in a pan, add whole cardamom pods and cloves, then sauté ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add chicken and cook until exterior turns opaque white.
Add onion-yogurt purée, coriander powder, cumin, and cashew nut paste; simmer on low heat for 15 minutes.
Finish with ground cardamom, cream, and a splash of rose water; garnish with toasted almonds.

recipes.title: Homestyle North Indian Chicken Curry (Tariwala Murgh)
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy pot, add whole cumin seeds and bay leaf until sizzling.
Add chopped onions and fry on medium heat for 12-15 minutes until rich golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste, cook 2 minutes, then stir in powdered spices and tomato purée; cook until oil releases from masala.
Add chicken pieces, tossing vigorously to sear in spice base for 5 minutes.
Pour in 1.5 cups warm water, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes until chicken is tender. Garnish with fresh cilantro.

recipes.title: Kerala Pepper Chicken Fry (Kurumulaku Murgh)
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken, cut into small bone-in pieces
instructions: Marinate chicken in turmeric, 1 tbsp cracked black pepper, ginger-garlic paste, and salt for 30 minutes.
Heat coconut oil in a cast iron kadai; splutter curry leaves and crushed fennel seeds.
Add sliced onions and sauté until translucent.
Add chicken, cover, and cook in its own juices over medium-low heat for 20 minutes.
Remove lid, add remaining 1 tbsp cracked black pepper, and fry continuously on high heat for 8-10 minutes until chicken is dark, dry, and thoroughly coated in peppery masala.

recipes.title: Smoky Chicken Chettinad with Roasted Spices
ingredients: Chettinad Masala: dry-roast 6 dried red chilies, 1 tbsp coriander seeds, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp fennel, 1 tsp black peppercorns, 1 star anise, 2 tbsp freshly grated coconut; grind to fine paste
instructions: Dry roast all whole spices and coconut in a dry pan until deeply aromatic; grind with a splash of water into a thick paste.
Heat sesame or coconut oil in a pan; add curry leaves and sliced shallots, frying until golden.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft and pulpy.
Add chicken pieces and ground Chettinad masala, tossing to coat meat thoroughly.
Add 1 cup water, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes until chicken is tender and oil floats to surface.

recipes.title: Fragrant Kashmiri Chicken Rogan Josh
ingredients: 2 tbsp Kashmiri red chili powder (for vibrant red hue without burning heat)
instructions: Heat mustard oil in a heavy pot until smoking point; cool slightly, then add whole spices and pinch of asafoetida.
Add chicken pieces and sear over high heat for 6-8 minutes until lightly browned on edges.
Whisk Kashmiri chili powder, fennel powder, and dry ginger powder into yogurt.
Reduce heat to low and pour spiced yogurt into pot, stirring continuously so yogurt doesn't curdle.
Cover and simmer on low for 25 minutes until chicken is meltingly tender and gravy is a deep ruby-red.

recipes.title: Spiced Chicken Shawarma with Garlic Toum
ingredients: Warm flatbreads, pickles, and garlic toum sauce
instructions: Mix olive oil, lemon juice, cumin, coriander, paprika, turmeric, cinnamon, cloves, 1.5 tsp salt, and pepper into marinade.
Toss chicken thighs to coat completely and marinate for at least 4 hours.
Layer chicken thighs tightly overlapping on a rimmed baking sheet.
Broil on HIGH 6 inches from heat source for 18-22 minutes until edges are crispy and charred.
Thinly slice chicken across grain and stuff into warm flatbreads with garlic toum and pickles.

recipes.title: Lebanese Shish Taouk (Garlic Lemon Chicken Skewers)
recipes.chicken_cut: boneless chicken breasts or thighs, cubed
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Whisk yogurt, lemon juice, crushed garlic, tomato paste, olive oil, oregano, allspice, salt, and pepper.
Toss chicken cubes in marinade and refrigerate for 4-8 hours.
Thread chicken onto skewers.
Grill over medium-high heat for 10-12 minutes, turning every 2-3 minutes, until lightly charred on edges and 165°F.
Slide hot chicken off skewers onto flatbread with garlic sauce, fries, and pickled turnips.

recipes.title: Moroccan Chicken Tagine with Preserved Lemon & Green Olives
ingredients: 1 preserved lemon, peel finely diced (discard pulp)
1 large onion, grated or finely minced
1/4 tsp saffron threads soaked in 1/4 cup warm water
instructions: Mix grated onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric, saffron water, black pepper, and salt into marinade; rub onto chicken.
Heat olive oil in tagine or heavy Dutch oven; sear chicken pieces 5 minutes on each side.
Pour remaining marinade over chicken, cover tightly, and simmer on low heat for 35 minutes.
Stir in preserved lemon peel and green olives; simmer uncovered 10 minutes until sauce reduces to a rich, glossy gravy.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with crusty bread or couscous.

recipes.title: Palestinian Chicken Musakhan with Sumac & Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 4 large red onions, thinly sliced (about 6 cups)
instructions: Rub chicken legs with 2 tbsp sumac, allspice, cinnamon, cardamom, 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper; roast at 400°F for 40 minutes until golden.
In a wide skillet, cook sliced onions in remaining olive oil on low heat for 25 minutes until meltingly soft and sweet, but not browned.
Stir in remaining sumac and 1/2 tsp salt into onions until deep crimson.
Dip taboon flatbreads briefly into pan juices, arrange on a baking sheet, and spread thick layer of sumac onions over each bread.
Place a roasted chicken leg on each bread, scatter toasted pine nuts, and broil 3 minutes until edges of bread are crisp.

recipes.title: Persian Saffron Chicken with Barberries (Zereshk Polo ba Morgh)
ingredients: 1/2 tsp saffron threads ground and steeped in 3 tbsp warm water
2 tbsp butter and 1 tbsp sugar (for barberries)
Steamed Persian basmati rice with tahdig
instructions: Season chicken thighs with turmeric, salt, and pepper; sear in oil in a Dutch oven until golden; transfer to plate.
In same pot, sauté onions until golden brown; stir in tomato paste and cook 2 minutes.
Add half the steeped saffron water, lemon juice, 1.5 cups water, and salt.
Return chicken to pot, cover, and gently simmer for 35 minutes until sauce is glossy and chicken is tender.
Sauté barberries in butter with sugar and remaining saffron water for 1-2 minutes until plump; spoon over steamed saffron rice alongside braised chicken.

recipes.title: Turkish Tavuk Shish (Marinated Spiced Chicken Kebabs)
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken thighs, cut into 1.5-inch chunks
2 tbsp Turkish red pepper paste (biber salçası) or tomato paste
Turkish pide bread and sumac onions
instructions: Whisk yogurt, pepper paste, olive oil, garlic, oregano, cumin, Aleppo pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Toss chicken cubes in marinade and refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
Thread chicken chunks onto metal skewers, packing loosely.
Grill over hot coals for 10-12 minutes, turning frequently, until charred on exterior and juicy inside.
Serve over warm Turkish flatbread with thinly sliced red onions tossed in sumac and parsley.

recipes.title: Egyptian Molokhia with Garlic-Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 1 bag (14 oz) frozen minced jute leaves (molokhia), thawed
Cooked Egyptian short-grain rice with toasted vermicelli
instructions: Simmer chicken in water with onion, cardamom pods, and mastic for 40 minutes until tender; remove chicken, brush with butter, and broil to crisp skin.
Strain broth and bring 4 cups to a gentle simmer in a pot.
Whisk thawed minced molokhia into simmering broth; cook on lowest heat for 3-4 minutes without boiling.
Make the ta'sha: melt ghee in a small pan, add minced garlic and ground coriander, and fry until golden brown and intensely aromatic.
Pour sizzling ta'sha immediately into green molokhia pot (with the traditional gasp!); serve hot alongside the roasted chicken and vermicelli rice.

recipes.title: North African Harissa Roasted Chicken Thighs
ingredients: 3 tbsp spicy North African harissa paste
instructions: Mix harissa paste, olive oil, honey, minced garlic, cumin, coriander, and 1 tsp kosher salt.
Toss chicken thighs thoroughly in spicy marinade.
Arrange lemon slices on a rimmed baking sheet; place chicken thighs on top skin-side up.
Roast at 425°F for 30-35 minutes until skin is crackling, caramelized at edges, and internal temperature reaches 175°F.
Garnish with fresh mint and cilantro; serve with fluffy couscous or roasted vegetables.

recipes.title: Iraqi Chicken Biryani with Vermicelli and Almonds
ingredients: 1 tbsp Iraqi baharat spice blend (cumin, coriander, cinnamon, cardamom, black pepper, cloves)
instructions: Poach chicken with onions, bay leaves, and 1 tsp baharat for 25 minutes; drain and shred meat.
In a large pot, fry vermicelli in 2 tbsp ghee until deep golden brown; add soaked rice, 4 cups chicken broth, and 1 tsp baharat; cook until rice is tender and fluffy.
In a skillet, fry diced potatoes until golden; sauté raisins until plump, and toast almonds.
Toss shredded chicken with half the potato, raisin, and almond mixture.
Layer fragrant spiced rice onto a massive communal platter, heap spiced chicken over top, and crown with crispy fried vermicelli, almonds, and raisins.

recipes.title: Yemeni Chicken Mandi with Smoked Rice
ingredients: 1 whole chicken (3.5 lbs), split in half lengthwise
Mandi Spice: 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp coriander, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp ground cardamom, 1/2 tsp cloves, 1/2 tsp cinnamon
1 lump natural lump charcoal and 1 tsp ghee for smoking
instructions: Rub chicken halves thoroughly with half the mandi spice blend, olive oil, and 1.5 tsp salt.
In a roasting pan, combine soaked rice, remaining mandi spices, crushed black lime, green chilies, and 4 cups hot water.
Place a wire rack directly over roasting pan and set spiced chicken halves on rack so seasoned juices drip into rice as it cooks.
Cover entire pan tightly with double layer of heavy foil; bake at 375°F for 55 minutes.

Uncover, broil chicken 5 minutes to crisp skin. Place a small foil cup with hot glowing charcoal into center of rice, drop 1 tsp ghee onto coal, and seal foil for 10 minutes to infuse deep desert smoke.

recipes.title: Authentic Jamaican Jerk Chicken
ingredients: 3.5 lbs chicken leg quarters, poked with fork

Jerk Marinade: 4 Scotch bonnet peppers, 6 scallions, 4 cloves garlic, 2-inch ginger, 2 tbsp fresh thyme leaves, 1 tbsp allspice berries ground (pimento), 1/4 cup soy sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tbsp lime juice, 1 tbsp neutral oil blended smooth
instructions: Blend all marinade ingredients until smooth.
Score chicken leg quarters deeply and rub jerk paste all over, massaging into meat and under skin; marinate 12 to 24 hours.
Prepare grill for two-zone indirect cooking with wood chips.
Slowly cook chicken on cool side of grill with lid closed for 35 minutes, turning occasionally.
Move chicken directly over hot coals for final 10 minutes, brushing with reserved marinade, until deeply blistered and charred (175°F in thigh). Serve with rice and peas.

recipes.title: Jamaican Brown Stew Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs bone-in chicken cut into small pieces
2 tbsp Jamaican browning sauce (or dark brown sugar caramelized in oil)
1 diced onion, 1 bell pepper, 3 scallions, 4 sprigs fresh thyme
instructions: Season chicken with browning sauce, soy sauce, allspice, garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper; marinate 1 hour.
Sear chicken in hot oil in a heavy Dutch oven until deeply browned on all sides (8 mins); remove.
Sauté onion, bell pepper, and carrots in rendered pan juices for 5 minutes.
Return chicken to pot with stock and whole Scotch bonnet pepper on top.
Cover and simmer on low for 30 minutes until chicken is meltingly tender and rich mahogany gravy clings to spoon.

recipes.title: Trinidadian Curry Chicken with Potatoes
ingredients: 2.5 lbs chicken cut into small pieces
Green Seasoning: 1/2 cup culantro (shado beni) or cilantro, scallions, garlic, ginger, thyme blended
3 tbsp Caribbean curry powder (Chief or Betapac)
2 medium russet potatoes, peeled and cubed
instructions: Marinate chicken in 3 tbsp Trinidad green seasoning and salt for 1 hour.
In a heavy pot, mix curry powder with 3 tbsp water to form a smooth paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil; cook curry paste on medium heat for 2-3 minutes until curry 'blooms' and oil separates.
Add marinated chicken pieces and toss vigorously in cooked curry for 5 minutes (bunjol).
Add potato cubes, Scotch bonnet, and water; cover and simmer for 25 minutes until potatoes are fork-tender and curry sauce is velvety. Serve with dhalpuri roti or rice.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Doro Wat (Spicy Chicken Stew with Hard-Boiled Eggs)
ingredients: 2.5 lbs chicken pieces, soaked in lemon water and patted dry
4 large red onions, finely minced in food processor
6 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and pierced with fork
instructions: Cook dry minced onions in a heavy pot over medium-low heat without oil for 25 minutes, stirring frequently until water evaporates and onions turn deep purple-brown.
Add niter kibbeh, ginger-garlic paste, and berbere; fry gently on low heat for 10 minutes to develop deep flavor.
Add chicken pieces and 1/2 cup broth; cover and simmer gently on low heat for 35 minutes until chicken is tender.
Gently lower peeled hard-boiled eggs into dark crimson sauce and simmer 10 minutes so eggs absorb flavor.
Serve family-style on a large round platter of spongy injera bread.

recipes.title: Senegalese Poulet Yassa (Caramelized Onion & Mustard Chicken)
instructions: Marinate chicken and half the sliced onions in lime juice, Dijon mustard, garlic, salt, and black pepper for 4 hours.
Remove chicken from marinade and grill or broil for 8 minutes until lightly charred on exterior.
Heat oil in a Dutch oven; cook all sliced onions on low heat for 25 minutes until golden brown and caramelized.
Pour remaining marinade, chicken stock, and whole habanero into onions.
Add charred chicken pieces, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes until chicken is tender and onion sauce is rich, tangy, and deeply savory.

recipes.title: Nigerian Pepper Chicken (Spicy Party Chicken)
ingredients: Pepper Sauce: 3 red bell peppers, 3 habanero/scotch bonnet peppers, 1 large onion, 2 ripe tomatoes blended coarse
instructions: Season chicken with Maggi cubes, curry powder, thyme, and salt; boil in 1 cup water for 15 minutes until tender; reserve cooking broth.
Deep fry chicken pieces in hot oil for 4-5 minutes until crispy and golden brown; drain.
Boil blended coarse pepper mixture in a saucepan until liquid reduces by half.
Heat 1/4 cup oil in skillet; fry cooked pepper sauce for 10 minutes until oil bubbles to surface.
Pour in 1/2 cup reserved chicken broth, add fried chicken pieces, and toss vigorously over high heat until spicy sauce coats every piece.

recipes.title: South African Peri-Peri Grilled Chicken
recipes.cook_method: charcoal grilling & bird's eye chili baste
ingredients: Peri-Peri Sauce: 8 African bird's eye chilies (or red chilies), 1 roasted red bell pepper, 4 cloves garlic, 1/3 cup olive oil, 1/4 cup red wine vinegar, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp dried oregano blended smooth
instructions: Blend all peri-peri sauce ingredients into a smooth, fiery red sauce; simmer half of sauce for 5 minutes and reserve for table dipping.
Coat butterflied chicken thoroughly in remaining raw peri-peri marinade; refrigerate overnight.
Grill chicken over medium coals skin-side up for 20 minutes with lid closed.
Flip and grill skin-side down over hot coals for 15 minutes, brushing generously with peri-peri marinade, until skin is blistered and charred (165°F).
Serve with crispy potato wedges, charred lemon halves, and warm dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Ghanaian Chicken Groundnut (Peanut) Soup
ingredients: 1 cup smooth natural peanut butter (no added sugar)
Cooked fufu, boiled yams, or rice balls (omotuo)
instructions: Steam chicken in a large pot with blended ginger, garlic, half the onion, salt, and 1/2 cup water for 15 minutes.
In a saucepan, whisk peanut butter and tomato purée with 2 cups warm water; simmer on medium heat for 12 minutes stirring constantly until red oil separates on surface.
Pour cooked peanut-tomato mixture into the chicken pot through a fine strainer.
Add remaining 3 cups water and whole habaneros; simmer gently on low heat for 35 minutes until chicken is tender and peanut soup is rich and velvety.
Serve hot with fufu or rice.

recipes.title: Moroccan Chicken Pastilla (Sweet & Savory Filo Pie)
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken thighs, cooked with saffron, ginger, cinnamon, and shredded
4 large eggs beaten into chicken cooking juices
1 cup toasted almonds, crushed with 2 tbsp powdered sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon
Powdered sugar and ground cinnamon for dusting
instructions: Cook chicken with saffron, cinnamon stick, ginger, and onions; shred meat.
Whisk beaten eggs into simmering onion-chicken broth until eggs curdle into soft scrambled sauce; strain excess liquid.
Layer 5 buttered filo sheets in a round pie dish with edges hanging over.
Layer shredded chicken, followed by egg-onion layer, topped with crunchy cinnamon-sugar almond layer.
Fold overhang filo sheets over, top with 3 more buttered filo sheets, tucking edges under.
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes until deep golden brown and crisp; dust top with lattice pattern of powdered sugar and cinnamon.

recipes.title: Cuban Mojo Roast Chicken Quarters
ingredients: 1/2 cup bitter sour orange juice (or equal parts orange and lime juice)
8 cloves garlic, mashed into paste with 1 tbsp coarse salt
instructions: Pound garlic and salt in mortar to a paste; whisk with sour orange juice, olive oil, cumin, and oregano.
Pour mojo marinade over chicken leg quarters and sliced onion rings; marinate for 4-8 hours.
Spread onion rings across bottom of roasting pan; place chicken leg quarters on top.
Roast at 425°F for 40-45 minutes, spooning pan juices over chicken halfway through, until skin is crackling and meat is tender.
Serve with black beans, white rice, and sweet plantains (maduros).

recipes.title: Classic French Coq au Vin (Chicken in Red Wine)
ingredients: 1 bottle (750 ml) dry red wine (Pinot Noir or Burgundy)
6 oz thick bacon or lardons, diced
2 tbsp butter kneaded with 2 tbsp flour (beurre manié)
instructions: Fry diced bacon in a Dutch oven until crisp; remove bacon and leave rendered fat in pot.
Sear seasoned chicken pieces in bacon fat over medium-high heat until deep brown; remove chicken.
Sauté pearl onions, mushrooms, and carrots for 5 minutes.
Pour in red wine, scraping up browned fond; add garlic, thyme, chicken, and crisp bacon.
Cover and simmer on low for 40 minutes until chicken is tender; whisk in beurre manié to thicken wine sauce into glossy satin glaze.

recipes.title: French Poulet au Vinaigre (Chicken in Vinegar Sauce)
ingredients: 1/3 cup red wine vinegar or sherry vinegar
instructions: Season chicken thighs with salt and pepper; sear in butter and oil in a stainless skillet skin-side down for 7-8 minutes until crisp and golden; flip and cook 4 minutes; remove.
Add smashed garlic cloves to pan, then pour in red wine vinegar, boiling vigorously to reduce by 80% until syrupy.
Whisk in tomato paste and chicken stock, scraping browned bits.
Return chicken to pan, cover, and simmer on low for 15 minutes until cooked through (165°F); transfer chicken to platter.
Over low heat, whisk cold butter cubes one at a time into pan sauce until glossy and thick; stir in tarragon and pour over chicken.

recipes.title: Hungarian Chicken Paprikash (Paprikás Csirke)
ingredients: 1 cubanelle or green bell pepper, diced
Fresh egg nokedli (spaetzle) or egg noodles
instructions: Sauté finely diced onions in 2 tbsp oil or lard over medium heat for 8-10 minutes until soft.
Remove pot from heat and stir in sweet Hungarian paprika (taking off heat prevents paprika from burning bitter).
Return to heat; add chicken pieces, diced pepper, tomato, and chicken stock.
Cover and simmer gently for 35 minutes until chicken is fork tender.
In a bowl, whisk sour cream with flour and a ladle of hot cooking liquid; stir cream mixture into simmering sauce until smooth and thickened. Serve over egg dumplings.

recipes.title: Spanish Pollo al Ajillo (Garlic Chicken)
recipes.chicken_cut: bone-in chicken pieces cut into small chunks
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken cut into small bite-sized bone-in pieces
15 cloves fresh garlic, peeled (10 sliced, 5 left whole)
1/2 cup extra virgin Spanish olive oil
1/2 cup dry white wine or dry sherry (Fino)
instructions: Season chicken pieces generously with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a wide cazuela or skillet; fry sliced garlic and whole garlic cloves with cayenne pepper on medium-low until golden and fragrant; remove garlic to avoid burning.
Turn heat to high; sear chicken pieces in garlic-infused oil for 10-12 minutes until crispy and golden.
Add dry sherry or white wine and bay leaf, scraping bottom of pan.
Simmer 5-7 minutes until wine reduces to a rich glossy glaze; return fried garlic to pan, toss with chopped parsley, and serve sizzling with rustic bread.

recipes.title: Spanish Arroz con Pollo with Saffron and Bell Peppers
ingredients: 2 cups Bomba or Valencia short-grain rice
1/2 tsp saffron threads steeped in warm water
1 red bell pepper, sliced into strips
instructions: Brown seasoned chicken thighs in olive oil in a wide paella pan for 10 minutes; remove.
Sauté red bell pepper strips until blistered; remove half for garnish.
Add diced onion and garlic to pan; cook 5 minutes, then add tomatoes and cook to a thick sofrito.
Stir in rice, coating grains in oil and sofrito for 2 minutes.
Pour in hot chicken stock and saffron water; nestle browned chicken and bell peppers on top.
Simmer uncovered for 18-20 minutes without stirring to develop bottom crust (socarrat); scatter peas on top, rest 5 minutes, and serve.

recipes.title: Georgian Chakhokhbili (Tomato, Herb & Garlic Braised Chicken)
recipes.chicken_cut: bone-in chicken thighs cut into pieces
ingredients: 2.5 lbs chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized bone-in pieces
4 large ripe tomatoes, peeled and chopped
1/2 cup fresh purple basil or Italian basil
instructions: Dry-sear chicken pieces in a hot heavy Dutch oven with NO added oil for 8-10 minutes, letting natural chicken fat render and brown meat; remove.
Cook sliced onions in rendered chicken fat until soft and translucent.
Add chopped fresh tomatoes, coriander powder, fenugreek, garlic, and salt; simmer 5 minutes.
Return seared chicken to pot, cover, and gently simmer for 20 minutes in the natural tomato juices.
Remove lid, stir in massive mound of fresh cilantro, basil, and dill; cook 2 minutes off heat. Serve with crusty shoti bread.

recipes.title: Austrian Chicken Schnitzel with Lingonberry Jam
ingredients: 4 chicken cutlets, pounded 1/8-inch thin between plastic wrap
2 eggs beaten with 1 tbsp heavy cream
Clarified butter or neutral oil for shallow frying
Lemon wheels and wild lingonberry jam
instructions: Season pounded cutlets with salt and pepper; dredge in flour, dip in egg-cream mixture, then coat gently in breadcrumbs without pressing down (light breading creates puffed wavy crust).
Heat 1/2 inch clarified butter in a large skillet to 340°F (170°C).
Slide schnitzel into hot fat; gently swirl pan back and forth continuously so hot butter washes over top of schnitzel, puffing the breading.
Flip after 2 minutes and cook 2 minutes more until pale golden and crisp; drain.
Serve immediately with a lemon wheel and a spoonful of tart lingonberry jam.

recipes.title: French Poulet Rôti (Classic Sunday Roast Chicken)
ingredients: 4 tbsp unsalted butter at room temperature
1 head of garlic, cut in half crosswise
1 cup chicken stock for pan sauce
instructions: Pat whole chicken dry inside and out; season cavity with salt, pepper, half head of garlic, lemon, and fresh herbs.
Tie legs together with kitchen twine and tuck wing tips.
Smear softened butter generously over entire skin; season exterior liberally with kosher salt.
Place breast-side up on a V-rack in roasting pan.
Roast at 425°F for 15 minutes, then reduce oven to 375°F and roast for 55-60 minutes, basting with pan juices every 20 minutes until thigh reaches 175°F.
Rest 15 minutes; carve and serve with deglazed pan drippings.

recipes.title: Portuguese Frango Piri Piri with Garlic Roast Potatoes
ingredients: 1 whole chicken (3.5 lbs), butterflied and flattened
1/3 cup piri-piri sauce (hot red chilies, garlic, olive oil, bay leaf, lemon juice blended)
Small Yukon gold potatoes, boiled and crushed
instructions: Marinate butterflied chicken in piri-piri sauce, white wine, and 1 tbsp salt for at least 6 hours.
Place on charcoal grill skin-side up over medium-low indirect heat for 25 minutes.
Flip over hot coals, brushing continuously with melted butter and piri-piri sauce every 3 minutes for 12-15 minutes until skin is crackling and charred.
Toss crushed boiled potatoes in piri-piri oil and crisp alongside chicken.
Carve into pieces and serve with fries or crushed potatoes and extra spicy sauce.

recipes.title: Russian Chicken Kiev with Herb Garlic Butter Center
ingredients: Compound Butter: 1/2 cup softened butter, 3 cloves minced garlic, 2 tbsp minced parsley, 1 tbsp minced dill, 1 tsp lemon juice rolled into a log and frozen solid
1/2 cup flour, 2 eggs beaten, 1.5 cups breadcrumbs
instructions: Slice a frozen cylinder of herb garlic butter into 4 equal fingers.
Pound chicken breasts flat between plastic wrap.
Place a frozen butter finger in center of each pounded breast; roll chicken tightly around butter, tucking ends in securely so butter cannot leak during cooking.
Double bread: dredge in flour, egg, breadcrumbs, back into egg, and breadcrumbs again to ensure leak-proof crust; chill 30 minutes.
Fry in 350°F oil for 5 minutes until golden, then finish in 375°F oven for 12 minutes. Cut open tableside to let aromatic melted herb butter burst out.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Lemon Rosemary Chicken Thighs & Baby Potatoes
ingredients: 1.5 lbs baby Yukon gold potatoes, halved
instructions: Toss halved potatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper; spread around edges of a rimmed baking sheet.
Mix remaining olive oil, lemon juice, minced rosemary, garlic, salt, and pepper; rub over chicken thighs.
Nestle chicken thighs skin-side up in center of baking sheet between potatoes.
Roast at 425°F for 35 minutes until potatoes are golden crisp on cut side and chicken skin is shatteringly crisp (175°F in thigh).
Drizzle pan juices over potatoes and chicken before serving.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Pan-Seared Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 2 large chicken breasts, halved horizontally into 4 cutlets
instructions: Season cutlets with paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in a heavy stainless or cast iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear cutlets 4-5 minutes on first side without moving until golden crust forms.
Flip cutlets, add butter, smashed garlic, and thyme sprigs to pan.
Tilt skillet and spoon foaming aromatic garlic butter continuously over chicken for 3-4 minutes until cooked through (165°F). Rest 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Salsa Verde Shredded Chicken
recipes.chicken_cut: boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs
ingredients: 2.5 lbs boneless chicken thighs or breasts
1 jar (16 oz) quality salsa verde (tomatillo salsa)
instructions: Place chicken in slow cooker.
Scatter diced onions, cumin, garlic powder, oregano, and 1 tsp salt over chicken.
Pour jar of salsa verde evenly across top.
Cover and cook on LOW for 5-6 hours or HIGH for 3 hours until chicken shreds easily.
Shred chicken with two forks in the warm salsa verde juices; stir in fresh lime juice and chopped cilantro.
Use for burritos, tacos, salads, and rice bowls.

recipes.title: Air-Fryer Crispy Parmesan Herb Chicken Tenders
ingredients: Marinara or honey mustard for dipping
instructions: Dredge tenderloins in flour, dip in beaten eggs, and coat thoroughly in panko-Parmesan-herb mix.
Preheat air fryer to 400°F (200°C).
Arrange tenders in a single layer in air fryer basket with space between pieces; spray tops with avocado oil.
Air fry for 6 minutes, flip, spray other side, and air fry for 5-6 minutes more until golden brown and crunchy (165°F).
Serve hot with favorite dipping sauces.

recipes.title: Creamy Dijon Mustard & White Wine Chicken Skillet
instructions: Season thighs with salt and pepper; sear in olive oil in a wide skillet for 5-6 minutes per side until browned and cooked; transfer to plate.
Add minced shallot to skillet; cook 1 minute.
Pour in white wine and chicken stock, scraping up browned bits, and simmer 3 minutes until reduced by half.
Whisk in smooth Dijon mustard, whole grain mustard, and heavy cream; simmer gently 2 minutes until creamy.
Return chicken and juices to skillet to glaze with sauce; garnish with fresh tarragon.

recipes.title: Healthy Honey Ginger Soy Glazed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: Honey Ginger Glaze: 3 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce, 1 tbsp grated fresh ginger, 3 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp cornstarch whisked with 2 tbsp water
Steamed jasmine rice and sesame seeds
instructions: Season cutlets with salt and pepper; sear in olive oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes per side until golden; transfer to plate.
In same pan, pour in honey, soy sauce, grated ginger, minced garlic, rice vinegar, and cornstarch slurry.
Simmer glaze for 1-2 minutes until thick and glossy.
Return chicken cutlets to skillet and turn repeatedly to coat in sticky honey-ginger glaze.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and sliced green onions.

recipes.title: Smoky Chipotle Chicken Burrito Bowls
ingredients: 1.5 lbs chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
Bowl Components: 3 cups cooked brown or cilantro-lime rice, 1 can black beans rinsed, 1 cup roasted corn, 1 diced avocado, pico de gallo, cilantro
instructions: Toss chicken pieces with olive oil, chipotle powder, cumin, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Sear in a hot skillet over medium-high heat for 6-8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until deeply charred and cooked through.
Assemble 4 meal-prep bowls: add a base of cilantro-lime rice and black beans.
Top each bowl with a portion of smoky chipotle chicken, sweet corn, fresh pico de gallo, and sliced avocado.
Serve with lime wedges and hot sauce.

recipes.title: Cast-Iron Skillet Spiced Spatchcock Chicken with Chimichurri
ingredients: Chimichurri Sauce: 1 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley minced, 1/4 cup fresh oregano, 4 cloves garlic minced, 1/3 cup red wine vinegar, 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil, 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes
instructions: Flatten spatchcocked chicken; rub with olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Heat a 12-inch cast iron skillet over medium-high heat with 1 tbsp oil.
Place chicken skin-side down in hot skillet; weigh down with a second heavy cast iron skillet to maximize skin contact.
Cook on stovetop for 6 minutes until skin is deeply browned and crisp.
Remove top skillet weight, flip chicken, and immediately transfer skillet to 425°F oven for 35 minutes until 165°F.
Rest 10 minutes, carve, and serve with fresh zesty chimichurri.

recipes.title: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato & Basil Chicken Pesto Pasta
ingredients: 1.5 lbs chicken breasts, sliced into strips
12 oz penne or rigatoni pasta, cooked al dente
instructions: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta cooking water; drain.
Season chicken strips with Italian herbs, salt, and pepper; sear in olive oil in a wide skillet for 5-6 minutes until golden; remove.
In same pan, add sun-dried tomatoes, heavy cream, and basil pesto; simmer on medium-low for 2 minutes.
Whisk in grated Parmesan until smooth and melted.
Add cooked pasta and chicken into creamy pesto sauce, tossing to coat (adding splashes of reserved pasta water if needed). Garnish with fresh basil.

recipes.title: One-Pot Lemon Orzo Chicken Thighs with Baby Spinach
instructions: Season chicken thighs with oregano, salt, and pepper; sear skin-side down in a Dutch oven for 7-8 minutes until golden crisp; flip and sear 3 minutes; transfer to plate.
Pour off all but 1 tbsp fat; sauté diced onion and garlic for 3 minutes until softened.
Add dry orzo pasta and toast for 2 minutes, stirring continuously.
Pour in chicken broth, lemon zest, and lemon juice, scraping up browned bits from bottom of pot.
Nestle chicken thighs back on top of orzo; bring to simmer, cover, and cook on low heat for 15-18 minutes until orzo has absorbed liquid and chicken is cooked.
Stir baby spinach into hot orzo until wilted and scatter crumbled feta over top.
